Okay, so I'm trying to figure out when Jefferson Davis ended his fight in the Mexican-American War. I know he was a key figure in the Confederate States, but I'm not exactly sure about his role in that war. Let me start by breaking down the problem.

First, I need to identify who Jefferson Davis was. He was the president of the Confederate States of America, right? So, he was involved in the American Civil War, but I'm looking at his involvement in the Mexican-American War, which happened before the Civil War, from 1846 to 1848.

I remember that he was a military leader, so he must have been part of that conflict. I think he was a colonel in the Mississippi Rifles. I should check when his service ended in that war. Maybe he was involved in some significant battles, like Buena Vista. I think he was wounded there, which might have marked the end of his service.

I should look for reliable sources. Britannica is a good start. I'll search their biography of Jefferson Davis to see if they mention his service in the Mexican War and when it ended. If they do, that would be a solid source. Also, the Warfare History Network has an article about him in Mexico, which might provide more details.

Wait, the Rice University chronology page also mentions his involvement in the Mexican War. It lists events from 1846 to 1852, which includes his time in the war. I need to see if any of these events indicate when he left the service.

I'm a bit confused because some sources might not provide the exact end date. If I find conflicting dates, I should figure out which one is more credible. Typically, primary sources or scholarly articles are more reliable than general encyclopedic entries.

So, putting it all together, I'll check each source step by step. Start with Britannica, then Warfare History Network, and cross-reference with Rice University's chronology. If all point to the same date, that's the answer. If not, I'll go with the majority or the most credible source.

I think the key here is to ensure that the information is corroborated across multiple sources to avoid relying on a single source, which might have errors or incomplete information. This way, I can be more confident in the accuracy of the date when Jefferson Davis ended his fight in the Mexican-American War.
